P01.rationale: No human portrait or person is present anywhere on the page; it is entirely typographic.

P05.rationale: There are no case study sections or client portraits of any kind on this page.

P07.rationale: No social-proof apparatus — no logo wall, rating cards, review grid, or testimonials — is present.

P10.rationale: A large ghost letter 'A' is used as an oversized decorative typographic element in the upper-right background, functioning as a decorative numeral/glyph device.

P11.rationale: No data visualisations, charts, before/after comparisons, or cost-math graphics are present.

P12.rationale: The layout has a strong headline and a large pull-quote but leaves a significant empty band in the middle of the page, making it feel under-filled rather than magazine-dense.

P13.rationale: The dark slate background with the ghost letterform 'A' provides a subtle atmospheric texture rather than flat blankness.

P14.rationale: No full-bleed photo is used on this page, so the criterion is not applicable.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup (phone, laptop, book) appears anywhere on the page.

N07.rationale: The page is purely typographic with no imagery at all, so stock-photo genericness is not a concern, though the ghost-letter device is somewhat generic.

N08.rationale: There is a large, purposeless empty band roughly in the middle third of the page between the body text and the 'Kernaussage' section, creating noticeable dead whitespace.

N10.rationale: No text is placed over a busy photo; the ghost letterform behind text is low-contrast and does not impede readability.
